title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

As our Head of Revenue Operations, you will build and lead the operating system for profitable growth across dLocal’s global commercial motions. You’ll own forecasting, performance analytics, pricing/fee governance, GTM process and tooling, incentives design, and commercial enablement—partnering with Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations to drive disciplined execution and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop the end-to-end forecast, reporting, and analytics engine to inform targets, capacity planning, and quarterly business reviews, ensuring consistency and executive-ready “one source of truth”
  • Govern pricing and fees: review and adjust fee structures, approval workflows, and guardrails; maintain auditable changes and impact tracking across markets and payment methods
  • Assess, design, and iterate internal incentives and compensation models for Sales/AM/Partnerships to align behaviors to margin, revenue realization, and retention/expansion outcomes
  • Enhance and scale the sales process and tools (CRM/CPQ, revenue configuration, approval matrices), reducing cycle time and margin leakage while improving quote quality and data completeness
  • Partner with GTM teams on onboarding, training, and development: playbooks, training, certifications, and role-based enablement that increase ramp speed and win rates
  • Define and co-drive overall sales strategy with Commercial Leadership, translating strategy into quarterly plans, territories/coverage, goals, and operating cadences
  • Establish core RevOps KPIs and dashboards (pipeline health, conversion, pricing approval SLAs, discounting/margin, revenue realization) and run insights-to-action cadences with stakeholders
  • Build and lead a high-performing global Revenue Operations team; create a culture of ownership, measurable outcomes, and cross-functional collaboration with Sales, CS, Marketing, AM, Partnerships, Finance, Product, Legal, and Operations
  • Partner with Market Intelligence and Sales Ops on pricing proposals, coverage by country/payment method, and “how we win” narratives to support commercial motions

What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years leading Revenue Operations and/or Sales Operations functions, including global scope and multi-stakeholder environments; prior experience leading remote global teams
  • Proven track record building forecasting, reports, and analytics that influence decisions at the executive level; strong command of BI and data tooling (e.g., Looker or similar). Hands-on experience in pricing/fee governance and approval frameworks across multi-country, multi-product contexts
  • Experience assessing and implementing incentives and compensation models that align with profitable growth and retention/expansion
  • Demonstrated process and tooling ownership across CRM/CPQ stacks; ability to translate business requirements into scalable systems and controls
  • Program leadership across onboarding, learning, and development for GTM teams; ability to design role-based enablement at scale
  • Strong project management and roadmap ownership; comfortable driving change in fast-paced, high-growth settings
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication; ability to resolve complex problems and trade-offs across Sales, CS, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations
  • Fluent in English; other languages are a plus

Nice to have

  • Fintech or payments domain experience (pay-ins, pay-outs, alternative payment methods, FX)
  • Experience working with Market Intelligence, pricing calculators, or commercial proposal frameworks in global contexts
  • AI-driven mentality with hands-on experience operationalizing AI/LLMs in go-to-market (GTM) processes and systems

Skills And Tools You May Use Here

  • CRM/CPQ and revenue tooling (requirements, implementation, and governance)
  • BI and analytics (e.g., Looker or similar), revenue attribution, and profitability analysis
  • Market/pricing intelligence and proposal workflows
  • Enablement platforms and content management for GTM teams

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Overview

Goodwork is recruiting for a fast-moving North American full-service creative agency serving startups, scaleups, and enterprise clients.

What makes this opportunity interesting?

  • Co-Founder’s strategic right-hand person, building systems that unlock leadership productivity while creating more efficient, happier creative teams
  • Work with industry leaders and fast-growing tech scaleups across North America
  • Lead projects and workflows using Zapier, Make.com, n8n, and AI tools alongside teammates from top companies

About the Company

We are the (un)agency for fast-moving teams that builds and grows brands. Our mission is long-term journeys with good people where there is mutual growth. We partner with fast-growing client teams and bring in curated expertise to rewrite traditional agency models—finding efficient, happy ways to do excellent work together.

We build world-class campaigns and digital products for innovative startups and multinational brands. Working at the intersection of strategy and creative, we handle branding, websites, landing pages, and campaigns as an on-demand fractional marketing team.

Our customers are mature, fast-growing tech scaleups (Series B+) with strong teams needing creative excellence. We serve larger enterprise customers and major web3 players, and have developed clusters in AI, energy tech, and health tech. Our portfolio includes TELUS Health, Validere, Transect, and Raising the Village across strategy, branding, advertising, design, and development.

We have replaced traditional agency trade-offs of cost, speed, and quality by delivering all three simultaneously. We’ve helped achieve 100x growth for multiple businesses, with clients averaging 5+ years with us (some 15+). We’ve never been fired, maintain a high NPS, and have grown entirely through word-of-mouth.

Our Company Values

  • Efficiency: Find the quickest path, build in the open, move fast and iterate, use data over opinions, adopt the latest AI and technology
  • Happiness: Lead with kindness, default to trust, support growth, provide flexibility and freedom
  • Mastery: Try many, keep few, trust experts, evolve together

We are a remote-first organization based in New York City with 50+ teammates, including 25 core members and 25 flexible contractors. Our team spans globally, and we bring in specialized talent for trials and specific projects, offering the autonomy of freelancing with the stability of full-time work.

This isn’t your typical workplace. We combine startup speed with the precision of true craft, automate everything possible, solve root causes, and grow through radical transparency. Our Pulse NPS is 4.75/5 with clients and team. We value product and craft, but people matter more.

About the Role

We’re seeking a remote Agency Operations Lead and the Founder’s right-hand person who makes our creative teams more efficient and happier. You’ll build workflows, automate processes, and solve operational problems so our Co-Founder and Project Managers can focus on high-impact work. A creative design sensibility and understanding of agency workflows are important.

You’ll spot bottlenecks, propose fixes, build systems, track what works, and tackle problems that slow us down. You’ll serve as the Co-Founder’s dependable right-hand, creating systems that increase productivity and foster a culture of efficiency.

We move fast with flexible processes. You won’t deal with clients extensively, but you need experience at top-tier companies that know how to scale. You’ll solve technical and people problems and help teams work better together. We’re looking for a rock star who can unblock leadership.

Ideal Candidate

3-5+ years in Creative Operations, Product Management, or Business Analysis roles with automation experience. You know workflow tools and business systems, plus you understand business context and strategy. What matters most is your ability to take ownership, execute without constant direction, ask the right questions for clarity, and make things happen. You should thrive in environments where priorities shift and structure is loose.

Performance will be measured by team feedback, speed of progress on key opportunities, independent execution, and teammate NPS – how much colleagues want to work with you.

You’ll be part of our Agency team and collaborate with Developers to build integrations and automations using no-code or low-code tools, and work with Project Managers and the broader Creative team. This position reports to the Co-Founder/Partner.

Responsibilities

  • Process Automation & Optimization: Interface with Project Managers to identify pain points, automate workflows for Designers, and architect systems where data is entered once and shared across Slack and Notion; collaborate with Developers on no-code/low-code integrations or build them when needed
  • Systems & Strategic Problem-Solving: Create scalable systems, tackle operational problems, maintain a learning/effectiveness log, act as the Co-Founder’s right-hand for strategic problem-solving
  • Financial Operations & Reporting: Handle end-of-month accounting and contractor reconciliation; optimize time tracking and billing; prepare client monthly sheets; extract profitability insights
  • Project Management Support: Manage granular tracking requests for enterprise clients; support Project Managers; coordinate special projects and internal tools development
  • Innovation & Special Projects: Support internal tool development and initiatives; help source new hires; research and implement time-saving tech solutions
  • Executive Support & Events: Organize expert roundtables for C-level executives; coordinate logistics; support founders as conversation facilitators; assist with work-related and occasional personal tasks

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years in roles such as Creative Operations Manager, Studio Operations Manager, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Systems & Operations, or Workflow Automation Expert
  • Clear communication, expectation setting, and end-to-end project management
  • Experience with workflow automation tools (Zapier, Make.com, n8n, or similar) and AI
  • Proficiency with Notion, Slack, Toggle, Airtable, and other PM tools
  • Bias for action: move fast, achieve small wins, iterate
  • Systems architecture and data analysis concepts
  • Ownership mentality and ability to run projects independently
  • Pragmatic, practical problem-solver with a mature understanding of business KPIs and workflows
  • Ability to learn new systems quickly and work without rigid structure

Bonus

  • Experience at creative agencies, startups, or product shops with tier-one brands
  • Development or technical background
  • Advanced data and BI skills
  • Portfolio showing automation projects or high-impact work
  • Advanced AI skills including prompt engineering
  • Entrepreneurial experience with measurable impact
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, Airtable, Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Toggle, Zapier, AI tools, HubSpot, Loom
  • Working Hours: Minimum 4 hours overlap between 8am-12pm ET; remaining hours are asynchronous
  • Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week), Exclusivity Preferred; part-time may be considered for exceptional applicants
  • Education: No specific requirements
  • Level: Intermediate (3-5 years of relevant experience)
  • Compensation: ~USD 2,116 – 2,301 per month, based on experience. Structured as a Consultant Agreement (independent contractor)

Benefits

  • Work with a forward-thinking international company
  • Remote work from home
  • Talented teammates and growth opportunities
  • All-expenses-paid international company retreats
  • Access to top brands and mentors
  • Modern tooling and AI tools
  • High autonomy

Not sure you meet all requirements? Apply anyway. We value diverse experiences and hire for potential.

Overview

Partner Relationship Manager

About The Role

Constellation Payment Processing is a modern Payment Facilitator (PayFac) empowering SaaS business to grow revenue through seamless, embedded payments. As part of Constellation Software Inc. (CSI) — a global Canadian-based software leader — we combine the agility of a specialized payments company with the strength and stability of an established global powerhouse.

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Partner Relationship Manager to join our team in the payments industry. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on assisting with complex problems, navigating internal and external challenges, and being the “go-to” person for partner success. The successful candidate will be accountable for identifying, investigating, and facilitating partner issues – including those involving third-party vendors – and ensuring a seamless experience across the Constellation Payments ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners using our payment solutions.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partner inquiries, concerns, feedback, and escalated issues – and ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
  • Track and chase down unresolved issues across departments and external providers until closure.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of partner workflows to anticipate and prevent potential issues.
  • Escalate system issues and advocate for partner needs within the organization.
  • Support partner onboarding and ensure successful integration with payment platforms.
  • Coordinate with other departments to proactively address risk and compliance issues.
  • Ensure partners are informed about regulatory changes and product updates.
  • Track partner interactions and maintain accurate records in CRM systems.
  • Prepare reports on partner engagement, support metrics, and satisfaction levels, and develop strategies to improve partner satisfaction and retention.
  • Be a champion for integrating AI into the PRM team and procedures.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Communications, or related field.
  • Proven experience in partner relationship management within the payments or fintech industry.
  • Strong understanding of payment platforms, transaction processing, and compliance requirements.
  • Proven experience in navigating cross-functional teams and third-party relationships to resolve customer or partner issues.
  • Demonstrated accountability in managing and resolving complex partner challenges.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite. Specifically strong excel skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple partner accounts and prioritize effectively.
  • High level of professionalism and partner-centric attitude.
  • Some travel could be required for company offsites and client visits (~20%).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with payment gateways, merchant services, or digital wallets.
  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, AML, and other regulatory standards.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CRM, CXM, Fintech, Salesforce).
  • Experience working with third-party vendors or service providers in payments or SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with issue tracking systems or escalation workflows.

Compensation, Benefits, and Work Environment

Work Location & Flexibility

Constellation Payments operates on a 100% remote-first model. We empower our employees with flexibility to work from home or a location of their choice within country of the job listing.

Salary & Performance Incentives

  • Target Compensation: The On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this role is projected to be between $75k and $105k per year.
  • Compensation Structure: This range is inclusive of the base salary and variable compensation, such as a company-wide bonus or sales commission. The final compensation package will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, capabilities, and location.

Employee Benefits

We are proud to offer a robust benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial future:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Retirement Plan: Secure your future with our 401(k) plan, featuring a company match that's 100% yours from day one.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Employees receive 15 paid vacation days, 5 paid sick days, and 1 paid personal day annually.
  • Company Ownership: Employees are invited to participate in our Employee Share Program (Ticker: TSE:CSU).

Equal Opportunity & Legal Disclosures

Constellation Payments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We comply with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this ordinance.

This position does not offer visa sponsorship. All applicants must have pre-existing legal authorization to work in the United States.

Our Culture

“I’m willing to let you scratch or dent the car, but I won’t put you in a position where there is significant risk of you totaling it.” - Ray Dalio

If this resonates with you, then you might have the grit we need for this role.

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. The Strategic Operations team at LastPass is a high-impact, cross-functional group that partners closely with executive leadership to drive business-critical initiatives. Our team thrives in ambiguity, builds scalable processes, and fosters collaboration across diverse functions to deliver measurable outcomes. As a remote-first organization, we value flexibility, transparency, and a shared commitment to operational excellence.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

As Principal Operations Manager, you’ll collaborate closely with LastPass executives, functional leaders, and cross-functional teams across product, go-to-market, customer success, and IT. You’ll be a trusted partner in driving strategic alignment and execution across the business. This role also works alongside other operations professionals to build scalable processes and foster transparency. Expect to engage with stakeholders at all levels, from senior leadership to frontline teams, to ensure initiatives are well-coordinated and impactful.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Drive strategic, cross-functional initiatives by developing clear structures, timelines, and forums that align with annual planning goals.

  • Guide the assessment, selection, and implementation of project management tools to improve execution and transparency.
  • Deliver executive-level dashboards and live updates that track progress on major initiatives and drive data-informed decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strength in conflict management and problem solving.
  • Fast learner with strong logical and analytical thinking, and hands-on experience with metrics and analytics.
  • Proficient in modern program management tools and processes, with a track record of creating order from ambiguity and solving unique, first-time problems.
  • Experience managing SaaS lifecycle initiatives, including product development, go-to-market, and customer lifecycle; high-velocity/SMB sales motion is a plus.
  • Demonstrated success in leading strategic initiatives, organizing and directing multiple teams, and managing cross-functional project portfolios.
  • Minimal travel may be required for company functions and team activities; primary locations include the Continental U.S. and Hungary.

The Front-End Department builds the Agoda web and app products. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for world class managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams.

By combining cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of user behavior, the team ensures the bots are intuitive, efficient, and aligned with business goals.

  • Excellent people management and communication skills

It's Great if you have:

  • Machine Learning, GPT, prompt engineering and other AI project experience
  • Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) or related AI/ML technologies is a significant plus

title: Associate Site Manager (CRA - Monitor de Pesquisa Clinica I)
description:
Overview

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at

Job Function: R&D Operations

Job Sub Function: Clinical Trial Support

Job Category: Professional

All Job Posting Locations: São Paulo, Brazil

Job Description:

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at:

We are searching for the best talents for these 8 Associate Site Manager (CRA - Monitor de Pesquisa Clinica I) positions.

Purpose

An Associate, Site Manager is an entry level site management role with typically 0-2 years of experience. This role serves as the primary contact point between the Sponsor and the Investigational Site. An Associate, Site Manager is assigned to trial sites to ensure inspection readiness through compliance with the clinical trial protocol, company Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulations and guidelines from study start-up through to site closure. Responsibilities may include assisting with site selection, site qualification assessment, subject recruitment and retention planning, site initiation, on-site and remote monitoring and close-out activities. The Associate, Site Manager will partner with the Local Trial Manager (LTM), Clinical Trial Assistant (CTA) and TDL (Trial Delivery Leader) to ensure overall site management while performing trial related activities for assigned protocols. May contribute to process improvement and training. Some supervision from a more Senior, Site Manager (Senior SM or Lead SM) to help provide guidance to Associate, Site Manager.

Principal Responsibilities

  1. Acts as primary local company contact for assigned sites for specific trials.
  2. May participate in site feasibility and/or Site Qualification Visit.
  3. Attends/participates in investigator meetings as needed.
  4. Responsible for executing activities within site initiation and start-up, preparation and conduct of site monitoring (including remote monitoring), site management (by study specific systems and other reports/dashboards) and site/study close-out according to SOPs, Work Instructions (WIs) and policies. Responsible for the implementation of analytical risk-based monitoring model at the site level and to work with site to ensure timely resolution of issues found during monitoring visits. Occasionally may require assistance or oversight from Lead, Site Manager or LTM.
  5. Ensures site staff are trained and the corresponding training records are complete and accurate at any time point during all trial phases. Responsible in close collaboration with LTM and central study team for the activities during site activation phase in order to speed up the process and activate the site in shortest possible timeframe.
  6. Contributes to site level recruitment strategy and contingency planning and implementation in partnership with other functional areas.
  7. Ensures site study supplies (such as Non-Investigational Product (IP), lab kits, etc.) are adequate for trial conduct.
  8. Ensures that clinical drug supplies are appropriately used, handled, and stored and returns are accurately inventoried and documented.
  9. Arranges for the appropriate destruction of clinical supplies.
  10. Ensures site staff complete data entry and resolve queries within expected timelines.
  11. Ensures accuracy, validity and completeness of data collected at trial sites.
  12. Ensures that all Adverse Events (AE)/Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)/Product Quality Complaints (PQC s) are reported within the required reporting timelines and documented as appropriate. For AEs/SAEs, ensures that they are consistent with all data collected and with the information in the source documents.
  13. Maintains complete, accurate and timely data and essential documents in relevant systems utilized for trial management.
  14. Fully documents trial related activities, in particular monitoring. Writes visit reports and follow-up letter in accordance with the SOPs. Promptly communicates relevant status information and issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  15. Reviews study files for completeness and ensures archiving retention requirements are met, including storage in a secure area at all times.
  16. Collaborates with LTM for documenting and communicating site/study progress and issues to trial central team.
  17. Active participation in regularly scheduled team meetings and trainings. Provide feedback as appropriate. May be asked to lead/provide leadership at these meetings.
  18. Complies with relevant training requirements. Act as local expert in assigned protocols. Develops therapeutic knowledge sufficient to support role and responsibilities.
  19. Works closely with LTM to ensure Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) is completed for Quality Assurance (QA) site audits and for quality issues identified at the site during routine monitoring and other visit types, e.g. Compliance Monitoring Visit (CMV).
  20. Prepares trial sites for close out, conduct final close out visit.
  21. Tracks costs at site level and ensure payments are made, if applicable.
  22. Establishes and maintains good working relationships with internal and external stakeholders in particular investigators, trial coordinators and other site staff.
  23. May participate in the Health Authority (HA) and IEC/IRB submission and notification processes as required/appropriate.
  24. Acts as a point of contact in site management practices.
  25. May contribute to process improvement and training.

Education and Experience Requirements

  • A minimum of a BA or BS degree in Pharmacy, Nursing, Life Sciences, or related scientific field (or equivalent experience) is required.
  • A minimum of 1 year of clinical trial monitoring experience is required. 1-2 years of clinical trial monitoring experience is preferred. However, other relevant experiences and skills may be considered by the hiring manager when considering the candidate’s eligibility.
  • Specific therapeutic area experiences an added advantage.
  • Basic working knowledge of GCP, company SOPs, local laws, and regulations, assigned protocols and associated protocol specific procedures including monitoring guidelines.
  • Strong IT skills in appropriate software and company systems.
  • Willingness to travel with occasional overnight stay away from home.
  • Proficient in speaking and writing the country language and English. Good written and oral communication.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Details

  • Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)
  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Results

INCLUIR XP - Assessoria de Investimentos (Exclusivo para pessoas com deficiência)

São Paulo, Curitiba. Brasília, Campinas e Ribeirão Preto

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório deagentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grandeecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra,determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente:Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande:Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta:Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor:Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Essa é uma oportunidade para pessoas com deficiência que desejam fazer parte do time da XP Inc.. Caso você não se identifique como parte esse grupo, confira nossas outras oportunidades na página de carreiras (AQUI).

Sobre a Oportunidade

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

  • É necessário que a pessoa candidata possua laudo médico atualizado e que se enquadrada nos critérios legais (conforme previsto pela lei de cotas).
  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar em São Paulo, Brasília, São Jose dos Campos, Campinas ou Curitiba (Praças onde temos vagas disponíveis).
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro);


Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.


Etapas do Processo

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  • Validação do Laudo: Análise das informações do laudo apresentado.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Etapa online, via Google Meet. Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Intra-Cellular Therapies Inc., part of Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine, is a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Bedminster, NJ. “We deliver innovative treatments to improve the lives of individuals suffering from neuropsychiatric, neurologic and other disorders”

They are also accountable for embodying and communicating Intra-Cellular's corporate vision of improving the lives of patients suffering from neuropsychiatric disorders.   • Maintains current understanding of local market, practice structures, evolving customers, and key influencers. Routinely shares such information with relevant internal Intra-Cellular stakeholders.
  • Provides input into resource allocation decisions across customers/region. Identifies and selects programs/resources available and appropriate for each customer, practice, and/or system.
  • Works with Regional Business Manager and key stakeholders to develop a local business plan that ensures achievement of all business objectives. Capitalizes on formulary approvals and other business opportunities through effective implementation of the strategic plan.

  • Accountable for providing timely and accurate administrative management of work hours, sales call data, customer objectives, communication responses, synchronization, sample and expense reporting.
  • Effectively inform and build a business plan based on depth and breadth of customer business needs, resources and products.

Job Requirements

  • 2+ years of previous sales experience in pharmaceuticals, biologics, or medical device sales required; 3+ years of sales experience in specialty pharmaceuticals preferred
  • Launch, antipsychotic, and/or bi-polar sales experience highly preferred.
  • Must have Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university as well as a valid driver's license and safe driving record.
  • Must have strong desire and passion for improving the lives of patients and their caregivers. Ideal candidate emulates patient-centricity.
  • Must act with high integrity and always in accordance with the Company's Compliance policies and procedures.
  • Must have strong sense of self-motivation, initiative, and entrepreneurial thirst, excellent decision-making judgment, strong teaming/collaboration and cross-functional skills
  • A proven track record of success in learning and adapting to an evolving environment such as Covid-19 in order to overcome obstacles and challenges
  • Must have ability to be agile and adapt to the changing telemedicine/virtual environment.
  • Ability to analyze data/metrics to assess progress against objectives as well as diagnose performance issues and identify new opportunities.
  • Experience establishing new customer relationships and communicating technical information to a diverse customer audience.
  • Work hours may include meetings scheduled outside of normal working hours.
  • Territories may require some overnight travel depending on geography.
  • Some domestic travel to corporate headquarters, training and sales meetings will also be required on a periodic basis.
  • Must be able to perform all essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Responsabilidades

  • Implementar, gerenciar e solucionar problemas em soluções de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR), como Always On Availability Groups e Replicação Transacional.
  • Gerenciar a segurança do banco de dados, incluindo usuários, roles, permissões, e implementar recursos como Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Data Masking e Row-Level Security.

  • Gerenciar e manter índices (Clustered, Non-Clustered, Columnstore) e estatísticas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de diagnóstico como SQL Profiler, Extended Events e DMVs para identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance.

  • Otimizar a configuração e uso do TempDB.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de concorrência, como Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Desenvolver T-SQL complexo, incluindo stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs, Dynamic SQL e manipulação de XML/JSON.

  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar Jobs complexos no SQL Server Agent.
  • Administrar ambientes de banco de dados na nuvem (Azure SQL Database, SQL Server em VMs - IaaS, Managed Instances - PaaS) e híbridos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Disaster Recovery na nuvem.
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory para fluxos de integração de dados.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e manter pacotes SSIS para migração e transformação de dados (ETL).
  • Implementar e gerenciar Change Data Capture (CDC) e Change Tracking.
  • Implementar monitoramento proativo da saúde dos bancos de dados e health checks.
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento de terceiros (ex: Redgate, DataDog SentryOne, SQL Monitor).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas de manutenção e criação de alertas.
  • Configurar, gerenciar e analisar logs de auditoria e monitoramento de atividades no SQL Server.
  • Implementar e gerenciar a automação de deployments de banco de dados (ex: Flyway, Liquibase, Redgate).
  • Integrar o gerenciamento de código de banco de dados com sistemas de controle de versão (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).
  • Integrar e manter deployments de banco de dados em pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas e projetos de banco de dados.
  • Orientar DBAs de níveis júnior e pleno.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre o ambiente de banco de dados.

Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência consolidada (8+ anos) em administração de banco de dados, com especialidade em SQL Server.
  • Profundo conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção do SQL Server (versões 2012, 2014, 2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Experiência prática com estratégias de Backup e Recovery
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança SQL Server
  • Experiência com requisitos de conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Domínio de Performance Tuning

  • Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e integração com ferramentas de BI

description:
Job description

Aqui na Korp, nossa cultura é movida por uma palavra: pessoas. Acreditamos que profissionais bem capacitados são pilares fundamentais da nossa empresa, por isso buscamos novos talentos para compor o time.

Para a vaga de Executivo de Pré-Vendas (SDR) , buscamos um profissional responsável por fazer a prospecção e um primeiro diagnóstico dos Leads para entender se ele é ou não é um cliente em potencial. O objetivo é gerar listas de oportunidades com PIC (sigla de Perfil Ideal de Cliente), mapeando a persona e criando o interesse nas soluções VIASOFT KORP, sabendo o que falar no momento certo para que o lead aceite avançar para uma reunião com executivos de negócios. Trata-se de um trabalho muito importante dentro da engenharia de vendas, pois dá celeridade nas vendas, já que o executivo hunter encaminha negociações com um excelente perfil de compra das soluções e abertura para conversa com as pessoas certas.

Essa oportunidade de carreira só faz sentido para quem:

Acredita no potencial que a tecnologia tem de dinamizar negócios, potencializar iniciativas empresariais e levar às melhores práticas de gestão;

Tem propósitos firmes de desenvolver carreira na área de vendas e enxerga nesta vaga a oportunidade e o meio para conquistar seus objetivos profissionais;

Tem vocação para identificar empresas com potencial para realizar ainda mais através do uso das nossas soluções;

Compreende que vender, acima de tudo, é ajudar o cliente a comprar;

Coloca o sucesso do cliente acima de qualquer interesse individual e jamais promete algo para fechar um negócio sem a certeza de que será capaz de atender;

Gosta de trabalhar com metas audaciosas.

Se identificou? então se inscreva na vaga!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar diariamente ligações telefônicas de prospecção para conversar com os responsáveis nas indústrias com PIC (perfil ideal de cliente) para soluções Korp;
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio para a VIASOFT KORP, pesquisando e encontrando empresas com PIC;
  • Identificar quem são as pessoas mais indicadas dentro da empresa potencial cliente a falar sobre soluções em software de gestão;
  • Extrair informações necessárias do lead para validar se as atividades econômicas da empresa e suas necessidades tem fit com o que a VIASOFT KORP oferece como soluções;
  • A partir da identificação que o lead possui um fit com as soluções VIASOFT KORP, tem a missão criar interesse nas soluções VIASOFT KORP e de “vender” a próxima etapa do processo de vendas: uma reunião com o executivo de negócios closer;
  • Manter atualizadas na plataforma de CRM todas as informações dos leads e as interações realizadas ao longo da prospecção;
  • Marcar reuniões na agenda dos executivos de negócios closer, para que possam dar continuidade nas negociações com leads qualificados;
  • Promover o “passe de bastão” ao executivo de negócios closer, deixando claro ao lead que estará direcionando as tratativas a outro profissional, mas que não é um abandono por parte do executivo hunter;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho: número de novas prospecções (leads novos contatados), taxa de conversão de leads com PIC em OPORTUNIDADE e OPORTUNIDADES transferidos;
  • Auxiliar na meta de número de OPORTUNIDADES qualificados.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência com prospecção ativa voltado para a venda de ERP;
  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Não só conhecer, mas também acreditar nas soluções que está vendendo;
  • Criatividade para contornar objeções;
  • Personalidade altamente motivada, persuasiva e orientada para o sucesso;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe de forma colaborativa;
  • Fortes habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 meses de experiência atuando com SDR;
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência com vendas de softwares, plataformas e aplicativos;

description:
Overview

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market. Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike. We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible. If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Data Scientist on the Product team, you will be responsible for:

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models to quantify the risk level of transactions and credit operations, and optimize user onboarding and reduce losses.
  • Design and conduct complex data analyses on large volumes of transactional, user behavior, and demographic data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for model enhancement.
  • Optimize and maintain existing credit models, ensuring their stability, accuracy, and business impact through continuous monitoring and refinement.
  • Lead the design and execution of A/B tests and other experiments related to credit decision strategies, translating results into actionable business recommendations.
  • Build and optimize robust and scalable data pipelines for model training, inference, and performance monitoring.
  • Contribute to the adoption of best practices in data science, including model documentation, version control (Git), and code quality.

Requirements

  • Experience in data science, with a proven track record of independently developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • Programming and Tools: Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark. Experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn. Familiarity with platforms like Databricks, AWS, and Azure. Experience with Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Analytical Modeling & Machine Learning: Strong experience in building and implementing machine learning models. Solid knowledge of classification, regression, and clustering algorithms, as well as feature engineering and model selection techniques. Experience with model explanation techniques.
  • Data Analysis: Ability to handle large datasets and write efficient, optimized SQL queries. Strong experience with exploratory data analysis and evaluating model features.
  • Statistical Knowledge: Strong understanding of A/B testing and statistics, including experimental design and statistical significance. Proficient knowledge of predictive modeling metrics like AUC, KS, precision, and recall.
  • Other Skills: Knowledge of data modeling principles and experience building robust and scalable data models. An analytical mindset with a strong focus on problem-solving. Strong mathematical skills with the ability to optimize complex problems.
  • Innovative Thinking: Applying theoretical knowledge of statistics, economics, and behavioral finance to optimize proposed solutions.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable business insights and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: Willingness to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment, actively contributing to team knowledge sharing.

Bonus Points

  • Proficiency with PySpark for distributed data processing in large-scale environments.
  • Experience with MLOps and deploying machine learning models into production.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring in production environments.
  • Exposure to Open Finance, credit bureau data, or behavioral features.
  • Previous experience in fintechs or financial services companies.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

We’re looking for a UI/UX Product Designer to join our team and help improve, expand, and evolve our SaaS platform, a growing suite of tools designed to help small businesses maximize their online presence. You’ll contribute to refining existing features, shaping new ones from concept to execution, and enhancing the overall usability and visual polish of the product as it grows. This is a collaborative role within a cross-functional team, working closely with engineering, QA, and stakeholders in an agile environment.

About the Company

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we’re blending technology and real-world expertise to empower businesses across the U.S. like never before.

We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That’s why we’re on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and, above all, grow sustainably without the hassle.

The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it’s no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations and contact management, drive leads, stabilize cash flow, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can reclaim their time to focus on what they do best.

Our Vision

We aim to be the ultimate all-in-one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly.

Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS-first company. By combining hard-earned human expertise with AI and automation, we’re creating affordable solutions that give business owners peace of mind while driving measurable success.

Why We Need You

As a UX/UI Product Designer , you’ll work closely with the product, engineering, and design teams to shape a tool that genuinely works for our small business clients. You’ll focus on refining the user experience across key areas of our platform like client social media accounts, online business listings, scheduling, invoicing, and client communications by designing clean, accessible, and intuitive interfaces that reflect how our customers actually work.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who understands real user needs and translates them into clear, intuitive flows and interfaces that deliver immediate value and keep users coming back.

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Translate product requirements into wireframes, flows, and prototypes that are simple, usable, and scalable
  • Design intuitive UI components that improve business workflows for our users
  • Work alongside engineers to ensure thoughtful implementation and visual quality
  • Participate in user research and usability testing to ground decisions in real user needs
  • Iterate quickly based on internal feedback and customer insights

What We Really Need From You

  • 3+ years of experience in product design, with a strong portfolio of real shipped work
  • Strong proficiency in Figma, including project handoff and the ability to work within existing design direction while expanding and evolving the interface as the product and feature suite grow
  • Ability to balance structure and flexibility in your designs, particularly across desktop and mobile
  • Experience working within a design system and contributing to its ongoing development
  • Intermediate English proficiency, both written and verbal required
  • Familiarity with B2B or SaaS platforms, ideally tools built for small business users
  • Comfort collaborating with product managers, engineers, and fellow designers throughout the lifecycle of a feature

What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Experience with user testing or conducting lightweight research
  • A solid eye for visual detail and a desire to make things feel clean, clear, and consistent
  • Excitement about working in a fast-moving environment where we’re building toward a bigger vision

What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay based on your experience.
  • Flexible work: 100% remote; Monday-Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm CST
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.

Why Choose Us?

Join us during this pivotal transition as we transform from an agency to a human-centric SaaS provider. Your ideas, strategies, and solutions will directly impact the success of small businesses. And our own growth!

Let’s shape the future of small business growth together! Apply now to join a team that’s as committed as they are supportive of each other.

Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here; it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

description:
Resumo da organização e atuação: Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a acreditação da JCI. Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, ampliamos nossa rede na região de Campinas com a inauguração de serviços como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e as unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. A consolidação regional incluiu ainda a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, localizada em prédio centenário, e a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do Hospital Care, grupo que atua com um modelo de gestão integrada para oferecer atendimento de alta complexidade, laboratórios, planos de saúde e centros médicos, presente em São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. A nossa estratégia é fortalecer a rede de prestadores de saúde para ser a melhor rede privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar as atividades e ações diárias do Serviço de Controle e Prevenção de Infecção Hospitalar (SCIH), analisando o senso diário e avaliando pacientes em longa permanência e em estado crítico.
  • Discutir casos de pacientes hospitalizados com a equipe do SCIH, visando diagnosticar infecções relacionadas à assistência à saúde e realizar metodologias de investigação (busca ativa de casos, investigações de casos suspeitos, avaliação de antimicrobianos na Ficha de Solicitação da Medicação e culturas com entrada no Laboratório de Microbiologia).
  • Analisar culturas solicitadas a pacientes internados, transcrevendo para o livro de registro e avaliando culturas retroativas para precaução ou isolamento, conforme necessário.
  • Realizar levantamento de dados via sistema sobre pacientes admitidos e respectivos diagnósticos.
  • Realizar vigilância NNISS (National Nosocomial Infections Surveillance System) em UTIs Adulto, Neonatal, Cardiológica e Pediátrica, acompanhando dispositivos invasivos e nutrição parenteral.
  • Atender às solicitações dos setores do hospital referentes ao controle de infecção hospitalar.
  • Realizar vigilância microbiológica, visitando o laboratório diariamente e acompanhando culturas.
  • Auditar setores para assegurar o cumprimento de protocolos de prevenção de infecção hospitalar.
  • Preencher ficha de doenças de notificação compulsória e discutir casos com a Vigilância em Saúde.
  • Preencher planilhas com dados microbiológicos das UTIs Adulto e Cardiológica e enviar mensalmente à coordenação.
  • Efetuar ligações a pacientes submetidos a procedimentos videoendoscópicos conforme normas vigentes.
  • Atualizar planilha de portadores de microrganismos multirresistentes e encaminhar aos Coordinadores de Enfermagem, Higiene e Limpeza e Central de Internação.
  • Elaborar e aplicar treinamentos para todos os setores e colaboradores, visando prevenir infecções hospitalares.
  • Realizar campanhas e publicar artigos informativos sobre Controle e Prevenção de Infecção Hospitalar e acompanhar visitas de Vigilância em Saúde.

title: Analista de Data Science Sênior
description:
Overview

Sinta a nossa energia! Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro: Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!

Sua energia será muito importante para fornecer insights valiosos que contribuam para garantir uma experiência positiva para nossos clientes, coletando, analisando e interpretando dados relacionados às interações dos clientes com a Neoenergia; ajudar a construir e manter estruturas automatizadas orientadas a dados e apoiar no roadmap de inteligência artificial e na tomada de decisões estratégicas baseadas em dados.

Responsabilidades

  • Trabalhar proativamente na análise, revisão e aprimoramento dos processos por meio de dados visando reduzir esforços, melhorar a experiência dos clientes e a eficiência de processos nas distribuidoras do grupo;
  • Identificar oportunidades de uso de dados para gerar valor traduzindo problemas de negócio complexos em hipóteses e modelos analíticos;
  • Estabelecer um plano abrangente para produtizar coleta, processamento, exploração e gerenciamento dos dados, garantindo flexibilidade para desenvolvimentos, além de sugerir, formular e gerenciar projetos baseados em dados que visam promover os interesses do negócio, mantendo processos de ponta conforme evolução da tecnologia e necessidades internas;
  • Desenvolver, monitorar e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT), atuando na extração, carga, transformação e análise dos dados, consolidação de métricas, geração de relatórios e apresentação de resultados;
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas de dados em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente Microsoft Azure);
  • Desenvolver colaborativamente ferramentas, aplicações, APIs, modelos analíticos como serviços etc. para serem amplamente consumidos;
  • Realizar debug, correção e melhoria contínua de pipelines existentes;
  • Monitorar e garantir a integridade e qualidade dos dados ao longo das pipelines;
  • Implementar mecanismos de controle e monitoramento de custos em serviços de dados na nuvem;
  • Estabelecer padrões de boas práticas (coding standards, metodologias de experimentação e documentação);
  • Conduzir revisões de código e de arquitetura de soluções de dados;
  • Mentorar analistas de dados mais juniores apoiando no crescimento técnico;
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados para garantir a entrega de dados confiáveis;
  • Automatizar processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados;
  • Desenvolver automatizações robóticas de processos (RPA) visando melhorias de processos;
  • Interagir com áreas técnicas (TD, infraestrutura, segurança) para garantir conformidade e funcionamento do ambiente;
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender necessidades de dados e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas;
  • Relacionar-se com diversas áreas com boa comunicação, traduzindo temas técnicos em linguagem clara, adaptada ao público, mobilizando e acompanhando ações;
  • Analisar tendências e cenários e sugerir planos de ação;
  • Manter-se atualizado com avanços de ciência de dados, MLOps, inteligência artificial generativa e estatística aplicada;
  • Testar novas ferramentas, frameworks e metodologias que possam trazer ganhos de produtividade, desempenho ou impacto;
  • Estimular a cultura data-driven participando da definição de roadmap de dados e de inteligência artificial.

Obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Estatística, Física, Economia ou Matemática;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office intermediário (ênfase em Power Point e Excel);
  • Conhecimentos em computação em nuvem para dados (por exemplo, Azure ou AWS);
  • Vivência em SQL e Ferramentas de Visualização de dados;
  • Vivência em linguagem de programação (preferencialmente Python com pacotes estatísticos, de manipulação e de visualização de dados e conhecimento em computação paralela, com Spark);
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento e troubleshooting de pipelines;
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Visão crítica sobre eficiência de processos e custos operacionais;
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento de projetos em Engenharia de Dados / Data Science;
  • Vivência em projeto de desenvolvimento, avaliação e implantação de modelagem preditiva, aprendizado de máquina e/ou análise avançada;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Campinas/SP.

Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em modelagem matemática (determinística e probabilística) para aplicá-las ao negócio (ex.: machine learning, clusterização, programação linear e não-linear, pesquisa operacional, séries temporais etc.);
  • Conhecimento em Gestão em Projetos Ágeis e desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Conhecimento em GitHub;
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas legados e bancos de dados (como Oracle e SAP);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automatização (BluePrism, UIPath, Automation Anywhere etc.);
  • CNH B;
  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (ex: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform);
  • Experiência com controle e análise de custos em ambientes de nuvem;
  • Entendimento sobre inteligência artificial discriminativa e generativa.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa
  • Licença maternidade estendida, para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade;
  • Licença paternidade, para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê;
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos, porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família;
  • Trabalho Híbrido para colaboradores administrativos;
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia;
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma;
  • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar com o cuidado dos seus filhos;
  • Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo;
  • Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos.

description:
Job description

A JusCash é uma startup que trabalha na precificação de créditos judiciais para advogados (conheça detalhes no site

Somos formados por gente inquieta e empreendedora, que valoriza o trabalho em equipe e acredita que o crescimento sustentável se dá a partir de pessoas que amam o que fazem. Estamos em busca de pessoas engajadas, que tenham brilho no olho e muita vontade de se desenvolver e crescer com a gente.

Como Product Owner , você irá exercer um papel de muito importante no crescimento da JusCash e de nossos produtos, se tornando responsável pelas atividades abaixo.

Main responsibilities

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Documentar processos, iniciativas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite em histórias, garantindo alinhamento e clareza para o time.

  • Operar Projetos, garantindo roadmap, alinhamento entre times e a execução das iniciativas definidas em planning.
  • Gerir impedimentos, riscos e problemas que possam surgir dentro da demanda/produto, assegurando que a equipe de desenvolvimento compreenda as prioridades da sprint promovendo entregas dentro dos prazos e qualidade estabelecidos.
  • Criar e monitorar KPIs relacionados ao produto sob sua responsabilidade, inclusive realizando experimentos e sugerindo melhorias, reportando à gestão de produto.
  • Organizar, facilitar e participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, como daily, follow-up, planning, review, etc.
  • Comunicar o progresso e os resultados das entregas de forma clara para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Apoiar no processo de análise de mercado, identificando tendências e oportunidades.
  • Apoiar a condução de descobertas de hipóteses para evolução do demanda/produto, assegurando viabilidade operacional.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a gestão de produto para avaliar e propor soluções de automação e aprimoramento de processos.

Requirements and skills

Para ser o nosso novo talento você precisa ter:

  • Excelente comunicação, verbal e escrita para interagir com o seu time e demais áreas.
  • Boa organização e responsabilidade.
  • Raciocínio crítico.
  • Curiosidade, tendo hábito de buscar novos conhecimentos e se desenvolver.

E os seguintes conhecimentos e experiências:

  • Conhecimento prático de Kanban, Scrum, Design Thinking e Inceptions.
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos/backlog.
  • Experiência com projetos em IA.
  • Experiência anterior como Product Owner.

Não é obrigatório, mas, adoraremos se você tiver:

  • Experiência com gestão de projetos/backlog através de ferramentas específicas: Jira, Confluence e Jira Service.
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Direito ou experiência na área jurídica.
  • Formação ou certificações adicionais em Gestão de Produtos (ex.: Awari, Tera, FIAP, PM3 ou afins).
  • Experiência anterior como Product Owner em Legaltech.

Na JusCash, valorizamos o bem-estar e o desenvolvimento das pessoas. Confira os benefícios oferecidos:

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

We recognize these values aren’t for everyone. They’re challenging. UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

description:
About UNICEF

UNICEF is the world’s leading children’s rights organization, dedicated to promoting children’s survival, protection and development. UNICEF operates in 190 countries and territories and is funded entirely by voluntary contributions from individuals, businesses, foundations and governments. UNICEF has over 12,000 staff in more than 145 countries.

Consultancy Title: Strategic Partner Engagement Consultancy

Division/Duty Station: Programme Group/Education, NYHQ

Duration: 1 October 2025 – 31 March 2026

Home/Office Based: Remote

Background

Purpose of Activity/Assignment:

The global learning crisis is widening, with a growing disconnect between education and essential skills. This is compounded by humanitarian emergencies, climate change, and systemic education failures, disrupting learning for millions of children. UNICEF’s Education Strategy (2019–2030), Every Child Learns, positions innovation as a key driver of educational access and quality.

Within this framework, the Learning Passport—UNICEF’s flagship digital learning platform, co-developed with Microsoft—has emerged as a critical solution for delivering flexible, high-quality education, especially in crisis-affected and underserved contexts. It is active in over 48 countries and reaches more than 11 million learners. As it scales, a comprehensive strategic partnership approach is essential to ensure sustainability, reach and continued innovation of the programme.

To advance its Digital Learning Strategy (2025–2030), UNICEF is establishing a new Strategic Partner Engagement Consultancy. This consultancy will focus on managing critical partner negotiations, roadmaps and events, and delivering joint strategies and agreements to build the technical and programmatic foundations of the Learning Passport programme. The successful results will advance UNICEF’s Digital Learning Strategy and contribute to the goals of the upcoming Strategic Plan.

The consultant will work closely with the Learning Passport Global Lead to support targeted partnership negotiation and engagement workflows, guiding the technical strategic direction of agreements to deliver programmatic results, with a focus on executive engagements of UNICEF and its Learning Passport partners.

Additionally, the consultant will support the management of the Learning Passport Leadership Council under the direction of the Global Lead, collaborating with major Learning Passport partners. These efforts will contribute to the successful implementation of UNICEF’s Digital Learning Strategy by managing private sector engagements needed to scale digital learning initiatives globally.

Scope of Work

The consultant will provide time-bound, technical support to strategic donor engagement and partnership activities that enhance the growth, visibility and sustainability of UNICEF’s Learning Passport. This role supports the Digital Learning Strategy (2025–2030) by leveraging private sector expertise to scale digital learning solutions and integrate them into national systems. A key focus is managing and advancing UNICEF’s strategic partnership with a key donor, including renewal and design of Phase III of the collaboration, ensuring alignment with the Digital Learning Strategy’s pillars of system strengthening, AI integration, and teacher empowerment.

Additional tasks may include supporting donor recognition materials and maintaining tools such as a partnership tracker to inform stewardship efforts.

Key Activities

  1. Support the Learning Passport Lead in engaging with existing high-value partners, ensuring fulfillment of contractual commitments including bespoke donor reporting, visibility deliverables, participation in thought leadership opportunities, and tracking of agreed programmatic metrics.
  2. Assist in renewal and expansion of existing strategic engagements with key partners by supporting proposal development, strategic communications, and materials aligned with donor priorities.
  3. Provide technical and logistical support to the Learning Passport Leadership Council, including preparing briefing materials and facilitating communication and coordination with UNICEF focal points and Council stakeholders.
  4. Contribute to donor-facing briefs and written inputs to support UNICEF’s strategic positioning in digital learning, including participation in high-level advocacy and cross-sector dialogues on EdTech, digital public goods, and education in emergencies as appropriate.
  5. Collaborate with relevant teams to support development of visibility and recognition materials for the Learning Passport, ensuring alignment with UNICEF guidelines and elevating partner engagements and events.

Note: Some activities may be scheduled only if additional resources become available. This Terms of Reference (ToR) is advertised for six months, with possible extension depending on funding.

Terms of Reference / Key Deliverables

Work Assignment Overview / Deliverables / Outputs / Delivery deadline

  1. Strategic Partnerships & Donor Engagement
  2. Deliver 2 detailed proposal documents (1 Excel costing sheet, 1 Word narrative) to support Azure credit extension and sponsorship renewal. Draft 1 by Nov 2025; Final by March 2026.

Additional items across sections 2–4 are described in the original ToR and include timelines, workshop planning, donor reporting, field visits, and coordination with various UNICEF teams. The deliverables include donor proposals, briefing decks, meeting notes, visibility campaigns, and donor reports with associated deadlines (e.g., Dec 2025, Jan 2026, Feb 2026, Mar 2026).

  1. 2. Additional Strategic Partnerships and Donor Engagement

Education

  • In lieu of a master’s degree, a bachelor’s degree plus 4 years of additional work experience will be considered.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, and MS Outlook.

Knowledge / Expertise / Skills

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of relevant experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships, engaging with the private sector, and leading resource mobilization at national or international level.
  • Experience in developing and managing shared value partnerships across the UN with private and public sector partners, including multi-year, multi-million-dollar agreements; ability to lead strategic technology partnerships with private sector stakeholders.
  • Experience establishing high-level advisory councils or technical working groups focused on digital learning or EdTech is a strong asset.
  • Experience with UNICEF or another UN Agency is preferred; knowledge of UNICEF context essential.
